abstract: Authorizes autonomous survey vessel clearance and records nominal multibeam acoustic swaths
system_message:
You are the Marine operations controller (MVC). Your responsibilities include authorizing autonomous survey vessel clearances and recording nominal multibeam acoustic swaths for pipeline investigation operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Authorizes autonomous survey vessel clearance and records nominal multibeam acoustic swaths（VESSEL）
information_points.content:
MVC-VESSEL-8AO：For the Remotely operated crawl plan, autonomous survey vessel clearance is confirmed for candidate vessels to operate within the offshore pipeline exclusion zone, and its maximum multibeam acoustic swath reaches 260 m of across-track coverage at a nominal 450 m depth.
MVC-VESSEL-H5R：For the Towed deep-tow array plan, autonomous survey vessel clearance has not been granted for entry into the offshore pipeline safety exclusion perimeter, while its maximum multibeam acoustic swath provides 220 m of effective across-track coverage at the nominal 450 m search depth.
MVC-VESSEL-GTI：For the Autonomous bathymetric track plan, autonomous survey vessel clearance has been granted for candidate surface and uncrewed vessels entering the offshore pipeline safety exclusion perimeter, and its maximum multibeam acoustic swath is rated at 260 m effective across-track coverage at the nominal 450 m search depth.

information_points.title: Vessel bunker consumption（FUEL）
information_points.content:
MVC-FUEL-RIU：Regarding vessel bunker consumption for the Remotely operated crawl plan, daily diesel fuel consumption is documented at 14 t for the offshore survey support craft.
MVC-FUEL-6IX：Regarding vessel bunker consumption for the Towed deep-tow array plan, daily diesel fuel consumption for the offshore survey support craft totals 22 t per 24 hours.
MVC-FUEL-N0L：Regarding vessel bunker consumption for the Autonomous bathymetric track plan, the daily diesel fuel consumption for the offshore survey support craft is logged at 18 t.
